observation_at_adoption: run already in progress; source verification and artifact retrieval SHA256 check passed; exact replay not yet observed; no fallback permitted for this run

historical_environment.limitation: Original hosted VM was not a pinned container; full historical fingerprint not logged. Cannot retroactively claim environment equality.

capture_before_any_evolution: immutable OCI image digest if containerized, otherwise runner image/version and OS/kernel
Python full version and build flags
Numba/llvmlite versions and CPU target/fastmath/parallel flags
installed wheel hashes and package lock
future_environment_policy.new_controlled_pair: For future independent numerical reruns, freeze same OCI digest, package wheel hashes and CPU target, set thread variables to 1 in both baseline and repair run. Do not claim this reconstructs undocumented historical environment.
future_environment_policy.comparison: Strict exact mode is mandatory for active run. Future alternate mode must be chosen from evidence about environment or artifact availability before new computation and recorded in a separate frozen protocol; never auto-fallback after observing numerical mismatch.

alternate_numeric_proposal_not_activated.condition: documented environment difference or artifact genuinely unavailable, separate new precommit required
alternate_numeric_proposal_not_activated.case_abs_relative_rule: for finite floating-point fields abs(x-y)<=1e-12+1e-10*max(abs(x),abs(y)); exact discrete fields, classification and steps; if artifact available same trace shape and dtype, elementwise same tolerance, no alignment; check near-zero flux separately; two independent same-environment coarse replays must match exactly
alternate_numeric_proposal_not_activated.claim_ceiling: NUMERICAL_REPLAY_ONLY, not historical byte equality; no scientific promotion based on fallback alone

future_additional_tests: numpy.str_ expected JSON string if actually present
numpy.ndarray rejected unless explicit schema requires array conversion; current report uses Python lists, arrays saved separately
serialization_scope.note: Do not broaden accepted serializer types unnecessarily; strict rejection is tested and no scientific data are silently coerced.

byte_comparison: Compare exact dtype, shape and C-order serialized array payload bytes (not object identity/address). NPZ ZIP envelope can differ due to metadata/compression; for future check also compare decompressed coarse.npy member bytes and separately verify original ZIP digest. Do not demand identical ZIP bytes across separate archives.
failure_policy: If current exact replay fails or ZIP cannot be fetched, TECHNICAL_SERIALIZATION_HOLD; no medium/fine evolution after gate failure, no compactness scientific conclusion. Any later fallback requires separate preregistration.

temporal_reporting.bands: TIGHT <=5%; MODERATE >5% to 15%; NEAR GATE >15% to 25%; FAIL >25%
temporal_reporting.requirement: Every NEAR GATE metric explicitly named in subsequent report with actual ratio, not only color. If none, report maximum measured ratio. No threshold change.
